articles.title: Horoscope for Friday, July 24, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

There are no restrictions to shopping or important decisions today. The moon is in Sagittarius.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A dynamic day

This is a lovely romantic day! In particular, it's the perfect day to tell someone how much you care for them. This might be a family member or someone who lives with you. It might be a co-worker, and of course, it could be a romantic interest.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

A positive day

All your conversations with others are charming today because you have the gift of gab. Your words are sweet, and people want to hear what you have to say. You might choose to tell siblings, relatives and neighbors something positive — something they will want to hear.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Financial discussions will go well today because you will be tactful, diplomatic and convincing in a subtle way. (They won't even see you coming.) Whatever transpires, you will be the one who is laughing all the way to the bank. You might also shop for beautiful things today.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

A positive day

This is a great day to play hooky. Today you'll enjoy reading for pleasure, socializing, enjoying concerts and doing anything where you can appreciate the beauty and talents of others. Visit art galleries, museums, architectural buildings and parks.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A dynamic day

Enjoy schmoozing today! Accept invitations to socialize. Sports events, the arts, museums, galleries and fun activities with kids will appeal. This is a very romantic day. New romance can begin, and existing relationships can blossom because it's easy for people to express their affection for each other.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

A positive day

Romance is in the air today, making this a lovely, sociable day! However, it's also an excellent day for you to buy wardrobe goodies. Enjoy the company of friends and groups. Someone's feedback or advice might be helpful. Bonus!

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A dynamic day

You can make great strides in whatever you want to do today because you make a great impression on parents, bosses, VIPs and the police. You can sweet-talk your way into or out of anything. It's also a popular day for you. Enjoy socializing, reading for amusement, concerts, art exhibits and sports.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

A positive day

This is the perfect day to explore avenues in higher education, publishing, the media, medicine, the law and anything related to travel. Doors will open for you because you're admired, well-spoken and convincing. You will hold people in the palm of your hand.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A dynamic day

This is a five-star day for you! The moon is in your sign dancing with lucky, moneybags Jupiter. You will find that financial discussions about shared property and anything jointly held with someone else will favor you. Ka-ching!

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

A positive day

This is the perfect day to tell someone close to you how much they mean to you. Tell them that you care. People love to hear this — we all do. And yet, so many of us leave it up to the imagination of someone very close. Travel plans look appealing!

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A dynamic day

Some of you might have a crush on a co-worker or a person involved with your health regimen. Whatever the case, today is the day to let someone know that you care. You might also get caught up in competitive sports and athletics because it appeals. Many exciting possibilities today!

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

A dynamic day

This is such a romantic day! Enjoy the company of loved ones. Do something special for your main squeeze. You will also enjoy appreciating the arts and creative work of others because your appreciation of beauty is heightened today.

If today is your birthday

Actress Elisabeth Moss (1982) shares your birthday today. You are energetic, sympathetic and sensitive. You have enthusiasm for what you believe. Exciting changes will bring you increased personal freedom this year. Stay flexible. Let go of whatever holds you back. Seek out new opportunities and be ready to act fast. Trust your intuition. Travel is likely.

articles.title: Environmental poliovirus detection declines across Pakistan, positivity falls to 13.1pc
articles.description: ISLAMABAD: Pakistan has recorded a significant decline in the detection of poliovirus in environmental samples during the first six months of 2026, with the positivity rate dropping from 48.1 per cent during the same period last year to 13.1pc this year. Prime Minister’s Focal Person for Polio Eradication Ayesha Raza Farooq told Dawn that the improvement was the result of a new strategy involving external audits, better team selection, enhanced training and the support of law enforcement agencies. However, a polio expert cautioned that unchecked cross-border movement from Afghanistan remained a major concern, as poliovirus strains linked to Kandahar and Nangarhar had been detected in environmental samples collected from Quetta and Peshawar, respectively. According to data released by the National Emergency Operations Centre (NEOC) for Polio Eradication, 127 environmental samples were collected across the country during June 2026 as part of routine poliovirus surveillance. Of these, 117 tested negative, while 10 samples were confirmed positive. The number of positive environmental samples detected between January and June also declined significantly, falling from 369 during the same period in 2025 to 100 this year. According to the NEOC, Punjab reported no positive environmental samples, with all 31 samples collected during June testing negative for poliovirus. In Sindh, 28 of the 29 samples tested negative, while one sample was positive. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa recorded 30 negative samples out of 34, whereas Balochistan reported 18 negative samples out of 23. The NEOC said the decline in environmental positivity reflected improvements in vaccination coverage and surveillance efforts, but stressed that sustained vigilance was essential to interrupt virus transmission. Pakistan has reported three wild poliovirus cases so far this year, with the NEOC intensifying surveillance and vaccination efforts in high-risk areas. It urged community leaders, religious scholars and healthcare professionals to support polio eradication efforts and appealed to the public to facilitate polio workers. Environmental surveillance is considered one of the key indicators of the effectiveness of polio vaccination campaigns. The detection of poliovirus in sewage samples indicates continued virus circulation and highlights gaps in immunisation coverage. While polio cases may emerge in different areas due to population movement, the presence of the virus in environmental samples points to shortcomings in vaccination efforts within those communities. Responding to a question, Farooq said the main challenges persisted in southern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Karachi. “We decided to conduct an external audit in Karachi, and based on its findings, new vaccination teams were selected and trained. We received full cooperation from the chief secretary of Sindh, which helped reduce the number of positive environmental samples to just one in the province during June. Karachi is densely populated, and routine immunisation coverage is also not satisfactory, so it requires continued attention,” she said. Regarding Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, she said access remained a major challenge. “We have involved law enforcement agencies as well as local communities. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is personally taking interest, and the entire team is committed to addressing the issue,” Farooq said. However, a polio expert, speaking on condition of anonymity, said the unchecked movement of people across the Pakistan-Afghanistan border remained the biggest challenge.

articles.title: Kids’ Fruit Pouches Recalled Nationwide Over Contamination Risk
articles.description: Pumpkin Tree Snacks Parents are being urged to check their pantries after a nationwide recall of select Pumpkin Tree Peter Rabbit Organics Banana & Strawberry fruit purée pouches over concerns they could contain plastic. PT Organics voluntarily recalled its 4-ounce pouches after discovering an internal packaging defect could cause a strand of the pouch’s inner material to detach and mix with the fruit purée. The company said the issue is limited to the packaging and does not involve the purée itself. No injuries have been reported, and no other Pumpkin Tree products or flavors are included in the recall. The company said customers should not consume the recalled pouches or feed them to children. “Consumers or caregivers who have recalled product in their possession should dispose of it or return the product to the place of purchase,” the company said. “It should not be eaten or fed to another person.” PT Organics described the recall as the first incident of its kind in the company’s 20 years of business. The affected pouches were sold exclusively at Target, Kroger, and Meijer stores nationwide between March 6 and July 13. Consumers can identify recalled products by checking for barcode 8 15367 01078 0, lane number 4, with best-before dates of Jan. 19, Jan. 20, March 17, March 18, May 14, or May 15, 2027.
